brief.name: TrailNote
brief.category: Offline hiking map and route recorder (fictional demo app)
brief.pitch: TrailNote lets hikers download regional maps, record their routes, and attach voice notes at waypoints, all without needing a signal.
mechanics: Download regional maps for offline use
Add voice notes at waypoints along a route
Import and export routes in GPX format
Battery saver mode to extend use on long hikes
brief.art_style: Topographic line art with muted earth tones, flat layered shapes, and restrained texture
brief.tone: Practical and outdoorsy: plain, confident, and unfussy
facts: Lets users download regional maps for offline use
Supports voice notes attached to waypoints
not_true: Does not provide an emergency rescue service
Does not guarantee weather conditions or forecasts
Does not guarantee route safety or navigation accuracy
Is a fictional product created for a portfolio demo, not a real app
brief.launch_goal: Convert users into paid upgrade trials
